The '''Citizen Guard''' was a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security force]] that served the [[Arkadianate]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] state that functioned in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. The Guard was made up of non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] volunteers, such as the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Seese]].
